mutations.name: the duration check is dropped from the render
kills: renderVideo refuses the page-longer-than-mix fixture and leaves no mp4 and no manifest

mutations.name: the manifest hard-codes the worker count
kills: renderVideo records the worker count it was given

mutations.name: a silent render is not marked draft
kills: renderVideo renders a silent draft with an AAC track, a header-only VTT and no words sha

mutations.name: a stale manifest survives a failed render
kills: renderVideo removes a manifest left by an earlier render when this one fails

mutations.name: beat starts are not passed to the capture
kills: renderVideo passes every beat start to the capture so chunks split on beats
